# t3.1 — Requirement Acceptance Traceability

**Purpose**: give every product requirement one deterministic, independently
testable customer scenario. These scenarios define observable acceptance only;
technical evidence is assigned later by architecture, planning, and testing.

## Observable Product Definitions

- **Active session**: a successful sign-in that has not expired or been revoked.
- **Verified recovery channel**: a customer-owned delivery destination that the
  product has confirmed and is still permitted for recovery.
- **Recovery authorization**: a single-use, expiring authorization valid for 30
  minutes; a newer authorization invalidates every older one for that recovery.
- **Throttled recovery/sign-in**: 5 unsuccessful attempts in a rolling 15-minute
  window trigger a 30-minute pause with generic retry guidance.
- **Available onboarding step**: its required provider, policy, legal approval,
  and customer evidence are all configured and active.
- **Recoverable unavailable state**: the product offers retry, a displayed wait,
  or a support path; it never leaves a dead end.
- **Ambiguous operation**: submission occurred, but neither a final success nor a
  final failure is established.
- **Provider-confirmed state**: an approved configured provider reported the
  final outcome; a local sandbox or saved draft never qualifies.

## Wave 1 — Security, Session, Recovery, and KYC-Ready Onboarding

| Scenario | Requirement | Given / When / Then |
|---|---|---|
| AC-001 | REQ-001 | **Given** an existing customer who could register and sign in before the change, **When** they repeat the supported journey, **Then** they reach the same customer outcome without changing already-supported inputs or meanings. |
| AC-002 | REQ-002 | **Given** invalid credentials, duplicate registration, malformed identity data, an expired session, or an unavailable sign-in service, **When** each case is submitted, **Then** the product gives a safe, non-revealing message and does not disclose whether a specific customer exists beyond the accepted legacy wording. |
| AC-003 | REQ-003 | **Given** a signed-in customer with visible account data, **When** they end the session and attempt a protected action, **Then** the product returns to sign-in and no authenticated account data is shown. |
| AC-004 | REQ-004 | **Given** current and other unrevoked sessions, **When** the customer opens session management and revokes one, **Then** every still-active session is listed with last-use/context, the selected session stops authorizing, and already expired or revoked sessions are not shown as active. |
| AC-005 | REQ-005 | **Given** a customer with a verified recovery channel, **When** they prove channel control and submit a 30-minute single-use authorization, **Then** the password reset is explicitly confirmed and older authorizations cannot be reused; without a verified channel, support is offered instead. |
| AC-006 | REQ-006 | **Given** 5 unsuccessful attempts in 15 minutes, **When** another attempt is made, **Then** the product pauses verification for 30 minutes and shows generic retry guidance without revealing identity existence. |
| AC-007 | REQ-007 | **Given** a legacy customer without a usable sign-in identity, **When** sign-in fails, **Then** the product opens a recoverable support-assisted state and successful recovery uses the existing customer record rather than creating another. |
| AC-008 | REQ-008 | **Given** onboarding in registration, review, pending-information, approved, rejected, or unconfigured provider state, **When** it is opened, **Then** exactly the truthful state and its allowed next action are shown. |
| AC-009 | REQ-009 | **Given** a KYC-ready request contains evidence and status, **When** no approved provider result exists, **Then** the product says review is pending/not configured and does not say the person is verified. |
| AC-010 | REQ-010 | **Given** personal evidence is about to be requested, **When** the onboarding step is evaluated, **Then** its purpose and provider/legal status are explained, and only an available step proceeds; otherwise it is disabled or informational with a safe next action. |
| AC-011 | REQ-011 | **Given** a completed sign-in, password change, recovery, or revocation, **When** the result is finalized, **Then** the product shows a confirmation and, if no delivery provider exists, explicitly labels external delivery as not configured. |

## Wave 2 — Provider-Ready Account and Reconciliation

| Scenario | Requirement | Given / When / Then |
|---|---|---|
| AC-012 | REQ-012 | **Given** each account lifecycle state, **When** the customer opens the account area, **Then** unconfigured, pending, active, failed, suspended, or reconciliation-needed guidance is visible without claiming an unavailable state is active. |
| AC-013 | REQ-013 | **Given** an account request that is submitted twice with the same intent, **When** the second submission completes, **Then** the original result is shown and no second account or request is visible. |
| AC-014 | REQ-014 | **Given** both simulated and provider-confirmed balances exist, **When** the customer reviews them, **Then** only the provider/reconciled value is labeled real balance and the simulated value remains separate. |
| AC-015 | REQ-015 | **Given** the same account status is returned by an approved test state and a configured provider, **When** the customer views each result, **Then** the customer-visible meaning and labels are equivalent. |
| AC-016 | REQ-016 | **Given** a money-affecting request transitions through several outcomes, **When** the customer reviews its history, **Then** submitted, accepted, completed, rejected, reversed, cancelled, and unknown outcomes remain distinguishable without overwriting earlier ones. |
| AC-017 | REQ-017 | **Given** provider and product records are compared, **When** matched, missing, duplicate, mismatched, or unresolved items are found, **Then** each result remains visible and neither source is silently replaced. |
| AC-018 | REQ-018 | **Given** a timeout followed by the same final response twice, **When** the customer reviews the result, **Then** there is one account, balance effect, receipt, or notification. |
| AC-019 | REQ-019 | **Given** a business-event notification is generated, **When** its delivery is pending, sent, failed, or unconfigured, **Then** the customer sees that truthful state and never sees “sent” for an unconfigured channel. |
| AC-020 | REQ-020 | **Given** an error involving sensitive provider or financial details, **When** the customer sees the error, **Then** no provider secret, full identifier, or reconciliation-only detail is present. |
| AC-021 | REQ-021 | **Given** no configured financial provider, **When** the customer attempts account opening or movement, **Then** the action is disabled or explicitly simulated and cannot create or claim a real-money operation. |

## Wave 3 — Pix, Transfer, and Boleto Flows

| Scenario | Requirement | Given / When / Then |
|---|---|---|
| AC-022 | REQ-022 | **Given** Pix, transfer, or bill payment, **When** the journey advances, **Then** review, confirmation, pending, completed, rejected, cancelled, and ambiguous states use consistent customer meanings. |
| AC-023 | REQ-023 | **Given** a payment ready for confirmation, **When** the review appears, **Then** destination, amount, date, disclosed fees, funding source, and simulated/provider-confirmed status are all visible. |
| AC-024 | REQ-024 | **Given** sensitive destination data is invalid, **When** validation fails, **Then** the product masks or omits the sensitive value in the result and generic customer/support messages. |
| AC-025 | REQ-025 | **Given** the same customer payment intent is confirmed twice, **When** both confirmations are processed, **Then** exactly one movement and one original outcome are visible. |
| AC-026 | REQ-026 | **Given** each possible blocked outcome, **When** the customer receives it, **Then** the reason differs for insufficient funds, limit, blocked destination, invalid data, rejection, timeout, and ambiguity, and exactly one safe next action is offered. |
| AC-027 | REQ-027 | **Given** a future scheduled payment, **When** it is created, listed, cancelled, executed, or fails, **Then** the current status and a truthful notification or failure guidance are available. |
| AC-028 | REQ-028 | **Given** a completed simulated or provider-confirmed payment, **When** the receipt opens, **Then** its truth state, unique reference, result, date, amount, and masked destination are visible. |
| AC-029 | REQ-029 | **Given** simulation is enabled, **When** a customer uses existing simulated balance, Pix, transfer, scheduling, bill payment, or statement behavior, **Then** the established simulated journey remains available. |
| AC-030 | REQ-030 | **Given** no configured payment provider, **When** a customer exercises a Pix, transfer, or bill journey in the approved test state, **Then** the complete journey can be reviewed without a real execution path. |

## Wave 4 — Cards, Credit, Investments, Insurance, and Support

| Scenario | Requirement | Given / When / Then |
|---|---|---|
| AC-031 | REQ-031 | **Given** an incomplete or simulated product catalog, **When** the customer opens the dashboard, **Then** every product area is discoverable and labeled active, informational, draft, simulated, or unavailable without implying a real product exists. |
| AC-032 | REQ-032 | **Given** card data in each provider lifecycle state, **When** the customer opens, reveals, hides, activates, blocks, unblocks, adjusts a limit, or reports loss, **Then** only the approved available actions are offered and no card existence is implied while unconfigured. |
| AC-033 | REQ-033 | **Given** a credit estimate and application, **When** the customer reviews or submits it, **Then** eligibility, assumptions, amount, term, fees, total, application status, and decline reason are visible without claiming a contract before approval. |
| AC-034 | REQ-034 | **Given** an investment estimate, offer, application, allocation, or confirmed position, **When** the customer opens its state, **Then** the product distinguishes each state and retains the existing calculator as an estimate only. |
| AC-035 | REQ-035 | **Given** an insurance quote, **When** a customer proceeds toward coverage, **Then** summary, exclusions, application, policy, and cancellation request states are distinct and no coverage is claimed before issuance. |
| AC-036 | REQ-036 | **Given** a categorized support request, **When** it is submitted, **Then** the customer receives a reference, can follow status, and can read response/dispute guidance without sharing credentials or complete financial secrets. |
| AC-037 | REQ-037 | **Given** a product provider is unconfigured, **When** the customer selects a product action, **Then** only information, saved draft, estimate, or explicit test state is allowed; no issuance, lending, purchase, or policy becomes real. |
| AC-038 | REQ-038 | **Given** a financial estimate, **When** it is viewed, **Then** existing disclaimers and the assumptions that distinguish estimation from provider-approved pricing are visible before any action. |

## Wave 5 — Observability, Antifraud, Limits, Audit, and Accessibility

| Scenario | Requirement | Given / When / Then |
|---|---|---|
| AC-039 | REQ-039 | **Given** one customer operation with retries and later reconciliation, **When** support follows it, **Then** one privacy-safe sequence distinguishes customer request, state changes, failure, retry, notification, and final outcome. |
| AC-040 | REQ-040 | **Given** a degraded or unavailable service, **When** the customer sees the result, **Then** retry, displayed wait, or support is offered and no technical error detail or secret is exposed. |
| AC-041 | REQ-041 | **Given** a fraud-sensitive operation, **When** it is evaluated, **Then** the product shows allowed, extra-verification, held-for-review, released, or rejected with a safe next action while hiding detection rules. |
| AC-042 | REQ-042 | **Given** an amount or count at or beyond an applicable limit, **When** the customer reaches review, **Then** the per-operation/daily/provider limit is visible before confirmation and exceeding it names the limit category and allowed next action. |
| AC-043 | REQ-043 | **Given** a security, onboarding, product, payment, support, or administrative action, **When** it is completed or changes, **Then** reviewable history records actor category, time, target category, outcome, and reason without deleting prior events. |
| AC-044 | REQ-044 | **Given** a review of product-operation history, **When** any event is opened, **Then** passwords, complete access secrets, full account identifiers, full payment codes, and unrelated personal data are absent. |
| AC-045 | REQ-045 | **Given** a keyboard-only or assistive-technology user, **When** they operate a new or changed primary flow, **Then** focus is visible, names and errors are meaningful, status is announced, dialogs behave correctly, and reading order is logical. |
| AC-046 | REQ-046 | **Given** sign-in, dashboard, onboarding, payment, product, and support in normal, error, loading, disabled, pending, and timeout states, **When** accessibility checks are run, **Then** zero critical WCAG 2.1 AA failures remain. |
| AC-047 | REQ-047 | **Given** a phone, tablet, and desktop viewport, **When** a customer completes each primary flow, **Then** essential content and controls are usable without task-blocking horizontal scrolling or clipping. |
| AC-048 | REQ-048 | **Given** every clarified supported current browser, **When** each primary flow is exercised, **Then** sign-in, navigation, submission, status, and completion remain usable. |
| AC-049 | REQ-049 | **Given** the existing visual identity and mobile-first patterns, **When** a flow is expanded, **Then** the established language and styling remain unless an accessibility or usability evidence item justifies a documented visible adjustment. |

## Wave 6 — Licensing and Legal Readiness

| Scenario | Requirement | Given / When / Then |
|---|---|---|
| AC-050 | REQ-050 | **Given** technical completion before the final wave, **When** Wave 6 status is reviewed, **Then** licensing/legal readiness is not claimed complete by earlier delivery and remains explicitly pending. |
| AC-051 | REQ-051 | **Given** a real product capability, **When** readiness is reviewed, **Then** required permissions, license dependencies, regulatory owner, responsible legal entity, and approval status are listed. |
| AC-052 | REQ-052 | **Given** an applicable customer product, **When** the customer reviews or accepts terms, **Then** the product records the applicable version of terms, privacy notice, consent, fees, complaints/disputes, and retention/deletion choices. |
| AC-053 | REQ-053 | **Given** provider and partner obligations, **When** readiness is assembled, **Then** responsibility for identity, screening, safeguarding/settlement, reconciliation, incidents, complaints, product rules, and data processing is explicitly assigned. |
| AC-054 | REQ-054 | **Given** a required legal or policy artifact, **When** it is reviewed, **Then** an owner, status, approval evidence, effective date, and update/withdrawal process exist. |
| AC-055 | REQ-055 | **Given** missing legal or provider approval, **When** a capability is offered, **Then** it is unavailable, simulated, or pilot-labeled and cannot imply production enablement. |
| AC-056 | REQ-056 | **Given** a final launch review with one unresolved approval, **When** sign-off is generated, **Then** the capability is blocked and excluded from production claims, and sign-off is not complete until zero blockers remain. |

## Cross-Wave Requirements

| Scenario | Requirement | Given / When / Then |
|---|---|---|
| AC-057 | REQ-057 | **Given** a new action in any wave, **When** each applicable state is reached, **Then** loading, success, error, unavailable, unconfigured, simulated, and confirmed-real treatment appears as required and states never collapse into a misleading success. |
| AC-058 | REQ-058 | **Given** an existing consumer using an already-supported operation, **When** a wave is delivered, **Then** the consumer completes its supported journey without changing the established input or result meaning. |
| AC-059 | REQ-059 | **Given** an existing customer journey, **When** a wave is complete, **Then** it remains behaviorally available unless an explicitly approved security or regulatory acceptance scenario supersedes it. |
| AC-060 | REQ-060 | **Given** any action and no configured, approved provider, **When** the action completes, **Then** no real money is created, sent, received, settled, or represented as real. |
| AC-061 | REQ-061 | **Given** a provider-dependent capability, **When** the safe test state supplies success, invalid input, rejection, timeout, duplicate, incomplete data, and later final response, **Then** every state is observable and truthfully labeled. |
| AC-062 | REQ-062 | **Given** the existing visual identity, language, and supported behavior, **When** each wave is reviewed, **Then** that baseline remains available with only documented accessibility/usability improvements. |
| AC-063 | REQ-063 | **Given** local tests or an unconfigured/sandbox state, **When** completion evidence is prepared, **Then** no provider integration, identity approval, legal approval, or real-money readiness claim is made. |
